sources.name: Producer
sources.expected: An XNYS session label represents a valid regular trading session. Publication as daily requires a truthful source interval declaration.
sources.observed: ISO complete dates are parsed and normalized, calendar is copied and frequency hardcoded to 1d. There is no source aggregation or supported-calendar validation in this path.

sources.name: Typed data boundary
sources.expected: Daily market_bars must have supported frequency and the consumer must reject contradictory labels before output.
sources.observed: Typed writer and reader require the fields and check adjustment and numeric invariants. Missing frequency is refused; a present explicit 1wk is not refused by those checks. Canonical content hash covers rows and schema.

sources.name: Mining
sources.expected: horizon_days is a count of trading sessions with causal entry after the decision.
sources.observed: Shared adjusted read enters observed-date panels and uses shifts by observed row index. Missing complete market dates and weekly bars can give longer economic periods than the label.

sources.name: Evaluation and benchmark
sources.expected: Valuation, delays, financing and annualization use the intended session axis. Daily benchmark gaps must not be bridged.
sources.observed: Run with no external benchmark and quantiles share the adjusted reader without a frequency gate. The external benchmark path rejects matching explicit non-1d metadata but only aligns to dates represented in market rows. The toy close-100/110/121 control traverses both retained closes after the middle market date is removed.
